policy: Figures, percentages, crisis numbers, deaths, payouts, claims, migration counts, vaccine counts, crime figures, money amounts, and court statistics must not be silently rewritten unless they match an explicit source rule. Source rules identify the source family and publication boundary; high-stakes figures still require the attributable record date and public review before promotion.

rules.label: Live Intel feed-derived updates
rules.scope: Counts of collected feed items, source lanes, updates and bulletins only; not the truth of every underlying claim.
rules.reviewNote: Feed-derived counts may update through the Live Intel Action because they come from the generated source ledger, not hand-written claims.

rules.label: Epstein source-watch lane and bulletin counts
rules.scope: Source-lane and bulletin counts only; no inference about a named person's knowledge, conduct or guilt.
rules.reviewNote: Counts generated from the source-watch file can update, but claims about people, victims or wrongdoing require role context and human review.

rules.label: Human Cost dashboard figures
rules.scope: Deaths, cases, claims, compensation and other human-cost figures with jurisdiction and period context.
rules.reviewNote: Human-cost figures are high-risk. Update only when the source record contains a named publisher and date and has been checked against the original public source.

rules.label: Migration and irregular immigration figures
rules.scope: Migration, asylum, border and related crime figures separated by country, period, population and offence definition.
rules.reviewNote: Migration figures must be tied to dated official datasets or named reports. Generic news snippets cannot authorize a public number change.

rules.label: Vaccine claims, payouts, and injury figures
rules.sourceName: Health compensation and regulatory source registry
rules.publisher: Named compensation authority, regulator or public-health agency required
rules.scope: Claims, awards, alleged injuries, deaths and rates with scheme, jurisdiction, eligibility and period boundaries.
rules.reviewNote: Health-related figures are high-stakes. Flag automatically, but require the attributable official record and human review before publication changes.

rules.label: Book, page, pack, feed, and generated inventory counts
rules.reviewNote: Site inventory counts can update automatically because they are derived from generated repository data.

rules.label: Crime, cartels, money laundering, and prosecution figures
rules.publisher: Named court, prosecutor, regulator or public agency required
rules.scope: Allegations, charges, convictions, seizures, arrests, prosecutions and attributed criminal-network figures.
rules.reviewNote: Crime and prosecution figures must come from attributable court records, official releases or cited primary public records before updating.

rules.label: Financial filings, assets under management, holdings, and market figures
rules.sourceName: Financial filing and market source registry
rules.publisher: Named issuer, regulator, exchange, or official filing repository required
rules.scope: Assets under management, holdings, ownership, revenue, market value, and other financial figures separated by entity, currency, reporting period, and filing type.
rules.reviewNote: Financial figures require the attributable filing or official release and its reporting period. A current-watch label is not a substitute for a source date.

rules.label: Static historical publication years and archival dates
rules.publisher: Named archival or publication source required
rules.scope: Historical years, publication dates and archival context already attached to the page.
rules.reviewNote: Historical years, publication dates and context dates must not be rewritten by freshness automation.
